audit_items.proof_trace: RPC layer promises serve range [max(currEpoch - MIN_EPOCHS, FULU_FORK_EPOCH), currEpoch] but storage independently prunes at retentionEpochs with no validation that retentionEpochs >= MIN_EPOCHS. TOCTOU race exists between validation and retrieval allowing pruning to occur mid-request.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker requests data at minimum valid slot when retentionEpochs < MIN_EPOCHS or times request near epoch boundary. RPC validation passes but storage returns empty, violating serve range invariant.
